reviews.review: "It's the perfect shooter roguelike, and I don't even like roguelikes. The items and enemies can get to insane levels that will have you playing for hours and wanting to do it all again once beaten."

I made a previous review and it didnt give the game enough credit this game is absolutely stunning 

Sound track: PEAK, Chris Christodoulou made some of the most beautiful sound tracks of all time and his music is all over my spotify now. Stavros Markonis ALSO made ABSOLUTE PEAK BOTH OF THESE COMPOSERS ARE AMAZING 

Game play: You will never Have the same game twice and after getting used to the base game getting even 1 DLC will change almost everything maybe even the way you play. The fighting in the game is so varied by the many different survivors and characters that if you ever get bored of the game all you might need to do is to switch your main character.

STORY: Believe it or not yes there is one though it's rather hard to follow for myself but you kinda get the gist of it when you start the game without skipping the cutscene 

Friends: It's a make or break on friends Less items to go around and more organizing to do but from my experience (Thought it's 80 hours rn) Having 2 players is the gold spot and if you know a tiny bit of math and each others playstyle and character then you both can make some killer runs and destroy bosses even on the hardest difficulty (HAHAHA) and on Monsoon it becomes liquid but very hectic 

The Visuals: I have a Laptop with a 3060 (6GB Vram) and a Ryzen 7 6000 series and the game will run pretty smoothly at 75 fps but when you get deep into your run you'll notice frame drops OTHER THAN THAT The graphics on this game are addicting I love them so much the lighting and the shadows are very good and most of all the backgrounds and in general the maps are gorgeous I sometimes wish there were no enemies and that I could just walk around and look at everything without all the combat but even in combat and going around the place you can really recognize the beauty of it all 


A VERY LARGE CAUTION IF YOU GET OVERWHELMED EASILY DO NOT PLAY THIS GAME It will make you cry or rage quit both are options and you don't have to choose one lol  


My thoughts: I could play this forever and not get bored of it Sometimes I play it to pass a couple hours quickly sometimes I do all nighters just cause I can and Didn't look at the time And I am sure that the story is well made I just havent gotten very far into it
